🌿 What Are Nasal Polyps?

Nasal polyps are soft, non-cancerous growths inside the nose or sinuses. Though painless, they can cause chronic nasal blockage, poor sense of smell, and repeated sinus infections.

They're commonly seen in people with:
✔️ Allergic Rhinitis
✔️ Asthma
✔️ Chronic Sinusitis
✔️ Dust/Mold Allergies

---

⚠️ Common Symptoms Include:

• Constant nasal stuffiness
• Dripping nose or postnasal drip
• Decreased or lost sense of smell
• Snoring or mouth breathing
• Headaches or facial pressure
• Recurring sinus infections

---

🩺 Do You Need Surgery?

Not always. Small polyps may shrink with nasal sprays or anti-allergy treatment. Larger polyps, or those unresponsive to medication, may need endoscopic sinus surgery—safe and scar-free.

🧹 Dust Allergy: The Invisible Trigger Behind ENT Problems

Dust allergy is one of the most common causes of repeated sneezing, sinus pain, throat irritation, and even ear blockage—especially in urban settings like Mumbai.

Invisible particles like dust mites, pollen, and indoor mold trigger your immune system, inflaming the nose, sinuses, and throat.

---

🤧 Common Dust Allergy Symptoms:

• Frequent sneezing or runny nose
• Nasal congestion, especially in the morning
• Itchy throat or dry cough
• Postnasal drip
• Pressure around eyes or cheeks
• Muffled hearing or ear popping

These symptoms may mimic a cold—but don't go away, and worsen with exposure to carpets, old books, or AC vents.

---

✅ ENT-Approved Solutions:

✔️ Use HEPA filters & vacuum regularly
✔️ Wash bedding weekly in hot water
✔️ Avoid dusty curtains, rugs, stuffed toys
✔️ Use antihistamines or nasal sprays (as advised)
✔️ Consult an ENT if symptoms are persistent or affect daily life

🌀 Why Nasal Infections Spike in Monsoon – ENT Advice by Dr. Chintan Nishar

🌧️ Monsoon brings relief from heat but also triggers a sharp rise in nasal infections.
🦠 High humidity creates a perfect environment for bacteria, viruses, and fungi to grow.
🌬️ Frequent sinus blockage causes facial pressure, nasal stuffiness, headaches, and fatigue.
🍃 Damp corners, mould, and dust mites in poorly ventilated homes worsen allergic rhinitis.
🌡️ Moving from cold AC indoors to humid outdoors weakens the nasal mucosa.
💧 Waterlogging and wet walls increase airborne microbes, raising infection risk.
🍔 Poor diet, low sunlight, and inactivity reduce immunity during this season.
🚨 Delayed treatment can lead to chronic sinusitis or fungal infections.

✅ Prevention Tips:
🧼 Keep your home dry, clean, and well-ventilated.
🥗 Eat a balanced diet and stay hydrated.

featured_reviews.name: sathiya Natesan
featured_reviews.review_text:
My mother had a swelling on her neck, and we were extremely worried because we had no idea what the actual cause was. At first, we consulted a local doctor who gave one week of medicines, but there was no improvement. Then we decided to take an USG scan. After the USG report, we went back to the same doctor, and she suggested doing an FNAC test. Even after doing that test, the doctor still couldn’t confirm the reason for the swelling and finally advised us to see an ENT specialist.

I started searching on Google and came across the reviews for Dr. Yash Devckar. The reviews were very positive, and they gave me confidence. We immediately booked an appointment — and that decision changed everything for us.

After consulting Dr. Yash, we finally got a clear understanding of my mother’s condition. He did not waste our time or money. He explained to us honestly that the USG and FNAC reports were not giving a clear diagnosis. Instead of guessing or giving temporary medicines, he immediately suggested important tests to find the exact cause of the neck swelling:
USG-guided FNA for Cytology, ZN Staining, GeneXpert, Pus Culture & Sensitivity, and Culture Tests.

He even took the extra effort to personally speak to the pathology doctor to make sure the right tests were done correctly. This shows his dedication towards his patients.

When the results came, we visited him again. He carefully checked everything and told us clearly that my mother was affected by Neck Tuberculosis (TB). He advised us to meet a TB specialist immediately and start medication without delay.

What touched us the most was that he did not even charge a consultation fee during this visit. His only goal was that my mother should receive the right treatment at the right time. His honesty, kindness, and concern truly saved my mother’s life.

If we had not met Dr. Yash at the right moment, we might still be wasting time doing random treatments without knowing the real problem. He opened our eyes and guided us in the correct direction.

Today, my mother has completed 2 and a half months of TB treatment and is feeling much better. Every day she remembers Dr. Yash and tells me to write a review for him. She says, “We found him through reviews, so our review should help another family who is suffering like us.”

Dr. Yash Devckar is the best ENT specialist in Chembur, also a wonderful human being. He truly cares for his patients, guides them honestly, and treats them with compassion.

We are extremely grateful to him. Thank you, doctor, for your guidance, your honesty 🙏
